info.name: P15 - Existing owner reads only
info.description: BE source-verified handoff, NOT a production activation. Read contracts: contracts/p15/owner-read-v1.json. Run only one selected read_id with an explicitly approved environment, existing actor/session/warehouse and original operation identity. Never create credentials, drafts, records or NFC mappings with this collection. No automatic login/refresh/contact/hardware action. All variables are intentionally empty. Supply access_token in a local environment and never export it. live_read_authorized and owner_gate_authorized must refer to independently approved evidence, not a bypass of P07/P06 gates. Save redacted raw evidence manually; do not upload customer data, cookies or tokens. Skipped requests and a successful collection run are not live acceptance. Turn OFF redirects. Use a Postman runtime supporting pm.execution.skipRequest; no Newman/CLI compatibility is claimed without validation.

exec: const stop = () => { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('P15 read blocked: verify approved environment, owner gate, mode and original identity.'); };

const specs = {P01_ME: ['', []], P03_CONTEXT: ['', []], P04_RECONCILE: ['P04_SCOPED', ['draft_id','operation_key','warehouse_id','scan_session_id']], P04_CURRENT_DRAFT: ['P04_SCOPED', ['draft_id','warehouse_id','scan_session_id']], P04_CURRENT_DOCUMENT: ['P04_SCOPED', ['business_document_id','warehouse_id']], P05_RECONCILE: ['P05_SOURCE_LINKED', ['draft_id','operation_key','warehouse_id','scan_session_id','source_document_id']], P05_CURRENT_DRAFT: ['P05_SOURCE_LINKED', ['draft_id','warehouse_id','scan_session_id','source_document_id']], P05_CURRENT_DOCUMENT: ['P05_SOURCE_LINKED', ['business_document_id','warehouse_id','source_document_id']], P07_CONFIRMATION: ['P07_CONFIRM', ['item_id','warehouse_id']], P07_CURRENT_TAG: ['P07_CONFIRM', ['physical_code_id','warehouse_id']]};
for (const key of spec[1]) if (!uuid.test(v(key))) stop();

if ((id.endsWith('RECONCILE') || id === 'P07_CONFIRMATION') && v('expected_http_status') === '200') { const states = id === 'P07_CONFIRMATION' ? ['SUCCEEDED','PROCESSING','UNKNOWN'] : ['SUCCEEDED','UNKNOWN']; if (!states.includes(v('expected_native_outcome'))) stop(); }
let trace = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'); if (trace === v('operation_key')) trace = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}');
const id = pm.info.requestName; const v = key => String(pm.variables.get(key) || '');
pm.test('Exact expected HTTP status; no inferred business outcome', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(Number(v('expected_http_status'))));
pm.test('Response is owner JSON, not an edge/proxy permission diagnosis', () => {
const d = body.data; const operation = id === 'P04_RECONCILE' ? 'INBOUND' : 'OUTBOUND';
const identity = {request_id:v('operation_key'), document_id:v('draft_id'), scan_session_id:v('scan_session_id'), warehouse_id:v('warehouse_id'), operation, command:v('command')};
else { for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(identity)) pm.expect(d.receipt[key]).to.eql(value); pm.expect(d.receipt.version).to.be.a('number'); }
// The current document may have advanced beyond the receipt version; do not equate them.

if (d.state === 'SUCCEEDED') { const c = d.response.data.confirmation; for (const key of ['actor_id','auth_session_id','warehouse_id','item_id']) pm.expect(c[key]).to.eql(v(key)); pm.expect(c.state).to.eql('SUCCEEDED'); if (v('physical_code_id')) pm.expect(c.physical_code_id).to.eql(v('physical_code_id')); if (v('hardware_uid')) pm.expect(d.response.data.nfc.hardware_uid).to.eql(v('hardware_uid').trim().toUpperCase()); }
// No response/PII/token persistence, no follow-up request and no writer retry.
